selection.bins: count strata, then equal-rank clearance halves, then equal-rank overlap halves
selection.empty_cell: fail; no substitution or label-based fallback
selection.gap_descriptor: minimum same-layer xy box clearance; board diagonal if no same-layer pair
selection.overlap_descriptor: sum of xy overlap areas over unordered opposite-net pairs
selection.representative: lowest salted geometry hash within each of twelve cells
selection.sentinels: one per count stratum: most conductors, then largest overlap, then smallest clearance, then salted hash
